description: Change the layer, ACI color, linetype, linetype scale, lineweight or visibility of existing entities, atomically and in memory: all change or none do. This is how to move entities to another layer (create it first with cad.create_symbol). Works on LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POINT, 3DFACE, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, ELLIPSE, SOLID, SPLINE and HATCH (the families with a byte-exact writer); other types, such as dimensions, are refused by name. Omitted properties are left alone. Hosted stored drawings auto-save; other drawings use cad.save_as.

color.description: ACI color: 0 BYBLOCK, 256 BYLAYER. Replaces any true color.

linetype.description: BYLAYER, BYBLOCK, CONTINUOUS or an existing linetype name.

name: cad.update_entities
